title: Financial News: Gyeonggi Northern police arrested 180 members of overseas phishing and money-laundering groups
date_note: The page gives only its own publication day (26 Nov); it does not state when the arrests took place.
geo_basis: country; the article names the Gyeonggi Northern Provincial Police Agency but no city
summary: Financial News reported on 26 November, from its own reporting, that a police probe that began with one loan-scam victim's report led to the arrest of 180 members of overseas phishing and money-laundering groups, 27 of whom were recently detained. The groups are suspected of taking 약 122억원 from 354 victims. Police asked for extradition of 4 suspects and issued Interpol red notices for 14 who fled abroad.
plain: Korean police are reported to have arrested 180 people in overseas phishing and money-laundering groups after one loan-scam report. Financial News says the groups are suspected of taking 약 122억원 from 354 victims.
exec: Financial News reports a police crackdown on overseas phishing and money-laundering groups: 180 arrested, suspected of taking 약 122억원 from 354 victims.

evidence.quote: 해외 피싱 조직과 자금세탁 조직의 조직원 등 180명을 검거하고 이 중 27명을 최근 구속했다.
해외 도주 피의자 14명에 대해 인터폴 적색수배 조치를 했다.
경찰은 피의자 4명에 대해 범죄인 인도를 청구하고

validation.note: Only Financial News (an exclusive report) was read; no police statement or second publisher read.
